items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of tree-felling exemption
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid ist innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe der Widerspruch bei der Stadt Musterfreiburg, Rathausplatz 2–4, 79098 Musterfreiburg, zulässig.
items.computation: Letter is dated 02.12.2026 (Wednesday); assuming postal dispatch on the same day, § 41 Abs. 2 LVwVfG deems it delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the 4th day after dispatch, i.e. 06.12.2026 (this fictitious delivery day is not itself shifted for weekends, per prevailing interpretation of § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG/LVwVfG). The one-month Widerspruchsfrist then runs under § 31 Abs. 1 LVwVfG i.V.m. §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe (06.12.2026) is not counted, the period starts 07.12.2026, and ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day, i.e. 06.01.2027. However, 06.01.2027 (Epiphany/Heilige Drei Könige) is a public holiday in Baden-Württemberg, so under § 31 Abs. 3 LVwVfG i.V.m. § 193 BGB the deadline moves to the next working day, 07.01.2027 (Thursday).

warnings: Due date assumes the letter was actually mailed on its printed date (02.12.2026); if postage was later, the four-day delivery fiction and the one-month deadline shift accordingly.
